title: مهندس ميكانيكي

source.site: صفحة وظائف شركة مهارة للموارد البشرية (Workable)
source.note: Read from Workable's public job search (jobs.workable.com/api/v1/jobs), the company's own Workable board; state published on 2026-11-21. Fresh-graduate posting: 'Fresh graduate with no previous work experience required.' and 'Must not be currently employed.' Arabic company name as already in the app.

bandEvidence: Fresh graduate with no previous work experience required.

requirements.evidence: Assist in reviewing mechanical drawings, designs, and technical specifications.
Support the coordination and follow-up of HVAC, fire protection, and plumbing systems.
Participate in occasional site visits when required.
Strong communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.
Coordinate with relevant teams to support project requirements and resolve technical issues.

summary: يدعم تصميم وتركيب وصيانة أنظمة التكييف ومكافحة الحريق والسباكة في مشاريع الشركة، والوظيفة لحديثي التخرج بلا خبرة سابقة.
tasks: متابعة أنظمة التكييف ومكافحة الحريق والسباكة

title: مهندس كهربائي

source.site: صفحة وظائف شركة مهارة للموارد البشرية (Workable)
source.note: Read from Workable's public job search (jobs.workable.com/api/v1/jobs), the company's own Workable board; state published on 2026-11-21. Fresh-graduate posting: 'Fresh graduate with no previous work experience required.' and 'Must not be currently employed.' Arabic company name as already in the app.

bandEvidence: Fresh graduate with no previous work experience required.

requirements.evidence: Review electrical drawings, technical specifications, and project documentation.
Basic knowledge of electrical systems, power distribution, and electrical design principles.
Participate in site inspections and follow up on field activities when required.
Ensure compliance with electrical safety procedures, quality standards, and project requirements.
Good communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.

summary: يساعد في تصميم الأنظمة والشبكات الكهربائية لمشاريع الشركة وتركيبها والإشراف عليها، والوظيفة لحديثي التخرج بلا خبرة سابقة.
tasks: مراجعة المخططات والمواصفات الكهربائية ووثائق المشروع
دعم تركيب المعدات الكهربائية واختبارها وتشغيلها
المشاركة في التفتيش الميداني ومتابعة أعمال الموقع
